title: basketVersion field renamed to version
query: What breaks across repositories if the basketVersion field is renamed to version in the basket API?

affected_repositories.name: basket-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: owns Basket.basketVersion, BasketResponse, BasketRow, and saveWithVersionGuard

affected_repositories.name: order-service
affected_repositories.evidence_note: Quote/Order/BasketClient carry basketVersion; quote validation rejects changed versions

affected_repositories.name: commerce-web
affected_repositories.evidence_note: BasketPage and api/types.ts submit and render basketVersion

notes: Optimistic-locking version as a contract field. The rename breaks quote creation and order placement: Order binds the version by name and rejects mismatches, so every checkout fails closed rather than silently.
